$comment: App-declared environment variables. Declare every variable this app reads beyond the platform-owned set; the Terp Studio deploy pipeline renders exactly the declared keys into a per-environment .app.env (see docker-compose.prod.yml), and `cp .app.env.example .app.env` exercises the same seam locally. Names match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$. Mark write-only secrets with "format": "secret" — their values are sealed, never stored in plain records. Platform-owned names (SECRET_KEY, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, DATABASE_URL, ENVIRONMENT, WEB_PORT, BACKEND_CORS_ORIGINS) are refused here. A declared variable must NOT also appear in a compose `environment:` block: compose resolves `environment:` over `env_file:`, so the declaration would be dead — `terp verify --only env-seams` fails on that overlap. For an address, set "resolvedBy" to who resolves it, because it cannot be inferred from the name or type: "container" (a service on the compose network dials it — use the service name, http://api:8000), "host" (your shell dials it — http://127.0.0.1:8000), or "browser" (the user's browser is sent there — a host address). See `terp guide environment`.
